items.title: Structured-Diffuser: Diffusion with Task-Conditioned Structured Priors for Motion Planning

items.title: VisTacAlign: Co-Training Dexterous Policies on Tactile Human and Robot Demonstrations

items.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

items.title: SUN: Agentic Robot Policy Learning with Persistent Task Programs

items.title: FRAM: Trajectory-Guided Visual Feature Selection for Compact Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation

items.title: Imp-ACT: Adaptive Impedance Control and Action Chunking with Transformers to Learn Contact-Rich Manipulation from Demonstrations

items.intro: arXiv:2608.06994v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding to generative motion planning. items.title: Decoupling Intention from Trajectory: A Representational Deduction Framework for World Action Models

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30036v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Planners built on visual world models commonly score each predicted outcome by its distance to the encoded goal image. items.title: See to Reach, Feel to Grasp: Learning A Blind Grasp Reflex for Anthropomorphic Robotic Hands

items.intro: arXiv:2609.29093v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continuum manipulators provide dexterous motion in confined spaces, but structural compliance, hysteresis, and load-dependent deformation leave residual position and orientation errors that can undermine reliable contact with rigid grippers. items.title: A Support-Enhanced Granular-Jamming Gripper for RL-based Grasping with Continuum Manipulators

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile humanoid manipulation requires both reaching a usable workspace and preserving precise hand-object interactions as object poses and contact conditions change. items.title: Praxis: Distilling Physical Interaction Priors from Egocentric Videos for Generalizable Whole-Body Manipulation

items.intro: arXiv:2609.31005v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D maps enable robots to reason about previously unknown environments using natural language. items.title: TRACKGRAPH: Online Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs via Image-Space Tracking

items.intro: arXiv:2609.31374v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Closed-loop driving simulation requires rendered observations to remain reliable as the ego vehicle and surrounding actors move beyond their recorded trajectories, exposing views absent from the source log. items.title: RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors

items.intro: arXiv:2608.11521v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: World action models (WAMs) condition robot actions on predicted futures, but iterative video rollout increases deployment latency. items.title: Keep the Future, Drop the Rollout: RIFT for World Action Models

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Precision manipulation with contact-critical interactions is often history-dependent: visually similar observations can correspond to different latent interaction states and therefore require different actions, while small execution errors can alter task outcomes. items.title: HIRE: History-Conditioned Interaction Reasoning and High-Rate Execution for Visually Aliased Precision Manipulation

items.title: SatNav: A Scalable Benchmark for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation from Satellite Imagery

items.intro: arXiv:2609.31412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the dynamic rotation-stacked visibility graph (dRVG), an online motion planner that guides polygonal robots to specified goals in initially unknown, static environ- ments. items.intro: arXiv:2609.30969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tactile information is essential for contact-rich manipulation tasks in robotics. items.title: TACTIC: Understanding Tactile Encoders and Conditioning for Contact-rich Robot Manipulation Policies

items.title: POIL: Point-based One-Shot Imitation Learning with Stable Dynamical Systems

items.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation

items.title: A Taxonomy of Construction Task Activities for Robot Workers

items.title: Modeling and Generative-AI-Based Design of Load-Adaptive Gravity Balancing Mechanisms

items.intro: arXiv:2609.30629v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mission-critical UAVs increasingly rely on split vision-language model (VLM) perception under tight onboard-resource and wireless-communication constraints. However, corruption of transmitted intermediate features creates a deployment mismatch for clean-trained split interfaces, while stronger channel-aware codecs can impose substantial onboard cost. items.title: FRESHLATENT: Channel-Aware Latent Adaptation for Resource-Constrained Embodied VLM Perception
